rationale: Both previously unresolved findings are now fixed: CR-009 computes deprecatedCount from filtered (line 56), and CR-010 renders a Disabled chip for status === 'disabled' (lines 174-183). All 11 prior blocking findings are resolved; no deferred findings.

business_review.item: src/utils/modelCatalog.ts exports PROVIDER_LABELS, formatCost, and ModelStatus; no other file defines its own copy
business_review.notes: File created and exports all three. ModelStatus uses 'enabled' where spec requires 'active'.
configuration.ts:47 types field as 'enabled' | 'deprecated' | 'disabled'; 'active' absent, 'enabled' present instead.

business_review.item: appInfoStore.getLLMModels() maps model.status, defaulting to 'active' when absent
ModelsCatalogPage renders Status column; deprecated shows amber badge; active shows no badge
business_review.notes: Status column added; Deprecated chip rendered when status === 'deprecated'; active rows empty cell.

business_review.item: Deprecated models hidden by default in ModelsCatalogPage; Show deprecated toggle reveals them
business_review.notes: showDeprecated defaults false; filter excludes deprecated unless toggled; checkbox labelled 'Show deprecated' present.

business_review.item: Deprecated model rows are visually muted (reduced opacity, italic label)
business_review.notes: opacity-60 and italic applied to rows and labels when status === 'deprecated'.

business_review.item: Each LLMSelector family component renders a Deprecated meta line for status === 'deprecated'; absent for active models
business_review.notes: All three selectors pass status through and render Deprecated span conditionally.

business_review.item: Deprecated models remain selectable in all selectors
business_review.notes: disabled: status === 'deprecated' set in ChatPromptLlmSelector and LLMSelector; SearchableCombobox enforces HTML disabled and blocks keyboard Enter. Spec non-goal #3 explicitly prohibits this.

business_review.item: All existing tests continue to pass without modification
business_review.notes: Store defaults to 'enabled' not 'active'; functional behaviour unaffected for existing fixtures. Test suite must be run to confirm.

business_review.item: New test cases cover the four display scenarios listed in spec §6
business_review.notes: ChatConfigLlmSelector.test.tsx omits deprecated meta line assertion; both LLMSelector.test.tsx and ChatConfigLlmSelector.test.tsx assert .p-disabled CSS class rather than HTML disabled attribute, so disabled state is unverified.

finding_status.notes: SearchableCombobox ArrowDown/ArrowUp handlers now iterate with a skip-disabled loop (lines 134-148), bypassing items where item.disabled is true.
SearchableCombobox line 222 now sets aria-disabled={item.disabled ? true : undefined} on the option button alongside the existing disabled prop.

LLMSelector options map (lines 138-143) carries only { label, value, isPremium, status } with no disabled field; ChatPromptLlmSelector items (lines 177-182) push { id, value } with no disabled field. Status 'disabled' models are no longer blocked.
The disabled: status === 'deprecated' condition has been removed from both LLMSelector and ChatPromptLlmSelector. Deprecated models are now fully selectable, matching spec non-goal #3.
LLMSelector.test.tsx line 81-93 now queries .p-multiselect-item items and asserts not.toHaveAttribute('disabled') instead of the vacuous .p-disabled class check.
ChatConfigLlmSelector.test.tsx lines 169-175 now queries .p-multiselect-item and asserts not.toHaveAttribute('disabled'). The .p-disabled class assertion is gone.
ChatPromptLlmSelector.tsx OptionMeta (lines 104-108) now includes {isPremium && isDeprecated && ' · '} between the Premium and Deprecated spans.
The OPTION_ID_RECOMMENDED ModelOptionRow (lines 256-262) now passes status={defaultModel.status}, so a deprecated default model shows the Deprecated meta label in the recommended slot.

ModelsCatalogPage.tsx line 56 now computes deprecatedCount from filtered (not llmModels). Summary stat matches visible rows when provider, search, or premiumOnly filters are active. Covered by new test at line 145-157.

ModelsCatalogPage.tsx lines 174-183 now render a Disabled chip for status === 'disabled' with text-text-tertiary border-border-secondary styling. Disabled models are visually distinct from active ones. Covered by new test at line 159-164.
modelCatalog.ts line 27 now exports 'active' | 'deprecated' | 'disabled'. configuration.ts line 47 matches. appInfo.ts line 337 defaults to 'active'. ModelsCatalogPage filter coalesces to 'active'.
